items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Elon, as I said, when Hamp raided my band and got Elon and Oscar Estelle--

ctx.x: I'll tell you another reason the Douglas Brothers didn't go further. Later Tommy played with Duke Ellington and Buck stayed in Chicago and Bill and I worked together with Nat Towles before he was drafted into the service. The reason they didn't go further is they had that great love for Kansas City, they didn't care to go anywhere. There was no need to go any further; Kansas City was a great jazz center then. It hasn't been in thirty something years.
That's the way it was with Elon Watkins. Elon, as I said, when Hamp raided my band and got Elon and Oscar Estelle--
